entries.title: FinCEN's MEXC Global special-measure order is published in the Federal Register at 91 FR 72420, effective December 10, 2026
entries.facts: FinCEN's order under section 9714(a) of the Combating Russian Money Laundering Act (Pub. L. 116-283), as amended by section 6106(b) of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2022 (Pub. L. 117-81), titled "Imposition of Special Measure Prohibiting the Transmittal of Funds Involving MEXC Global", was published in the Federal Register on November 10, 2026 as document 2026-22962, cited at 91 FR 72420 (pages 72420-72427, volume 91), with the action line "Order." and recorded against 31 CFR part 1010. The Federal Register record's DATES field states: "This action is effective December 10, 2026." The record's abstract states that the order finds MEXC Global, including its subsidiaries, branches, offices and any successor entities operating outside the United States, "is a financial institution operating outside of the United States of primary money laundering concern" in connection with Russian illicit finance, and that it prohibits certain transmittals of funds involving MEXC Global.
entries.source_label: Federal Register - FinCEN order, 91 FR 72420 (Nov. 10, 2026), document 2026-22962
entries.relevant_to: exchanges, payment processors, banks and money services businesses with convertible-virtual-currency exposure

entries.title: CFTC's DCM impartial-access interpretation is published in the Federal Register at 91 FR 72407, effective November 10, 2026
entries.facts: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission's interpretation titled "DCM Impartial Access Requirements" was published in the Federal Register on November 10, 2026 as document 2026-22863, cited at 91 FR 72407 (pages 72407-72410, volume 91), with the action line "Interpretation." and recorded against 17 CFR part 38 under docket CFTC-2026-2345. The Federal Register record's DATES field states: "Effective November 10, 2026." The record's abstract states that the Commission is issuing an interpretation of the impartial access requirements of Commission Regulation 38.151(b) as they apply to designated contract markets. The CFTC announced the interpretation in Release 9323-26, "CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation", dated November 05, 2026.
entries.source_label: Federal Register - CFTC interpretation, 91 FR 72407 (Nov. 10, 2026), document 2026-22863
entries.relevant_to: prediction-market platforms, event-contract and futures exchanges, designated contract markets
